lessons.title: Interaction leverage over mechanism complexity
lessons.rule: Prefer one simple physical interaction that creates a large perceptual change. Keep the mechanism visually secondary, physically credible, and achievable with few added parts.
lessons.avoid: Do not add a mechanism when movement creates little visual change, requires precision engineering disproportionate to the payoff, or becomes the visual hero instead of the effect.

lessons.title: Interaction must read in the image
lessons.rule: When WOW depends on interaction, make the causal chain visually legible: INPUT -> MECHANISM -> VISIBLE EFFECT. A viewer should understand the interaction even without reading the concept description.
lessons.avoid: Reject decorative-looking controls, hidden causal chains, and mechanisms whose effect cannot be inferred from the final object.
